definition.def: The author of a piece of writing is the person who wrote it.
examples: She is the joint author of a booklet on Integrated Education. [+ of]

definition.def: An author is a person whose job is writing books.
examples: ...Philip Pullman, the best-selling author of children's fiction.

definition.def: The author of a plan or proposal is the person who thinks of it and works out the details.
examples: The authors of the plan believe they can reach this point within about two years. [+ of]

definition.def: To author something means to be the author of it.
examples: Then he opened a restaurant, authored a book, and landed his own radio show. [VERB noun]
